From playing LeBron James’ son in Space Jam to grinding in an NFL training camp, Ceyair “Hollywood” Wright has one of the wildest stories in sports 👀 Before joining the Bengals as an undrafted free agent, Wright was a highly touted 4-star recruit who played college football at USC and Nebraska. But just as he was making noise in training camp, Hollywood came calling with an offer he simply couldn’t refuse. The 23-year-old defensive back has officially stepped away from the Bengals after landing the lead role in a major feature film 🎥 Cincinnati placed Wright on the Exempt/Left Squad list. And Head coach Zac Taylor gave his full support, acknowledging how tough the choice was when “two of his passions were colliding.” Production is expected to wrap in late October, and Wright remains fully committed to returning to the NFL once filming ends 🏈 Having to choose between fighting for an NFL roster spot and starring as the lead in a Hollywood movie is one incredible dilemma to have.
